_comment: PLAN.MD v3 section 5.5.2 - LLM tool catalog for Gemini function calling. Schema follows OpenAPI 3.0 subset supported by Gemini.

function_declarations.name: present_cards
function_declarations.description: Show 1-2 AAC cards to the user and have the NPC speak. Most frequently used tool. card_ids must reference existing cards in the active scenario.

card_ids.description: Card IDs to display, e.g. ['card_pharm_med_headache', 'card_pharm_med_cold']. Length 1-2.

npc_speech.description: NPC dialogue line in Korean (한국어). Short, friendly, 존댓말.

scaffold_level.description: Help intensity. 0=normal, 1=mild hint, 2=strong hint pointing at correct card.

function_declarations.name: mark_objective_complete
function_declarations.description: Mark the current objective as completed and update slot values. Always followed by present_cards or transition_to_objective on the next turn.

objective_id.description: The objective that just completed, e.g. 'identify_needs'.

slots_filled.description: Slot key-value pairs to set on the dialogue state. Keys must match the scenario's slot schema.

function_declarations.name: transition_to_objective
function_declarations.description: Move to the next objective explicitly with an NPC line bridging the transition. Use when natural conversation flow suggests progression.

function_declarations.name: enter_subflow
function_declarations.description: Enter a branching subflow when the user expresses a secondary intent (off_topic_but_valid). Main objective is pushed; pending_topic queued for later.

npc_speech.description: NPC line that acknowledges the subflow entry, in Korean (한국어).

suggested_cards.description: Cards to show in the subflow. Length 1-2.

pending_topic.description: Short label of the unhandled side-intent to remember (e.g. '복통 증상 구체화').

function_declarations.name: return_from_subflow
function_declarations.description: Exit current subflow and resume main objective. Update slots with anything captured during the subflow.

npc_speech.description: NPC line closing the subflow and bridging back, in Korean (한국어).

slots_filled.description: Slot updates captured during the subflow.

function_declarations.name: request_clarification
function_declarations.description: Ask the user to clarify when STT output is unintelligible or slot confidence is low. Show simpler card choices.

npc_speech.description: Clarification question in Korean (한국어). Gentle tone.

function_declarations.name: express_understanding
function_declarations.description: Empathetic response when user_distressed intent is detected. Pair with a single simplified card or no card.

npc_speech.description: Warm reassuring line in Korean (한국어). Short.

function_declarations.name: force_complete_scenario
function_declarations.description: End the scenario early when turn limit reached or repeated failures accumulate. NPC speaks the user's intended line on their behalf.

npc_speech.description: Closing line in Korean (한국어). Positive framing — never imply the user failed.
